data.name: InvalidKey
data.value: Storage keys must be nonempty, valid Unicode without control characters.

data.name: KeyTooLong
data.value: The storage key exceeds its UTF-8 byte limit. Use a shorter key; keys are never truncated or hashed.

data.name: InvalidScope
data.value: The storage scope is not canonical anonymous or partition JSON.

data.name: IncompatibleContext
data.value: The persistence context is incompatible with the agent or trusted partition scope.

data.name: MissingContext
data.value: Initialize the session persistence context explicitly before accessing history. Missing or invalid context cannot fall back to anonymous storage.

data.name: AlreadyInitialized
data.value: The session persistence context is already initialized.

data.name: InvalidRevision
data.value: A history revision must be nonnegative and cannot move backwards.

data.name: InvalidSchema
data.value: The session document schema is unsupported or its address does not match the requested address.

data.name: InvalidSnapshot
data.value: The serialized session must be a JSON object, not an escaped JSON string.

data.name: InvalidTtl
data.value: Document TTL must be -1 or a positive number of seconds.

data.name: SnapshotTooLarge
data.value: The complete serialized session document exceeds the 2,000,000-byte UTF-8 budget. Reduce the session snapshot before retrying; no write was attempted.

data.name: WrongContainerSchema
data.value: The Cosmos container must use the expected two hierarchical partition paths (MultiHash, version 2) and default TTL -1. Stop all writers, back up if needed, and manually recreate the old container before using this schema. No automatic deletion or migration is performed.
